title: Thank you, doctor.
description: A bilingual follow-up to Lesson 61: the doctor re-examines Jimmy, who is better but mustn't get up yet, and the joke ends with Mr. Williams in bed with a bad cold too. Includes workbook fill-in dialogue and word-choice practice, plus grammar on can-questions, how-long answers and because-clauses. 第61课的续集：医生复查吉米，他好些了但还不能起床，结尾处威廉斯先生也卧床得了重感冒。配合教材填空对话和选词练习，以及 can 问句、how long 回答和 because 从句的语法练习。
answer_note: The before-listening question has no official key and its answer is labelled suggested. Workbook answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 63 key (img/key-063-067.jpg). Grammar answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 63 grammar key (PDF viewer pages 495-496). No external sources were used.

lesson.text: Listen then answer this question. Who else is in bed today? Why?
lesson.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。还有谁今天也卧床休息？为什么？

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: Can I see him please, Mrs. Williams?
lines.translation: 我可以看看他吗，威廉斯夫人？

lines.speaker: Mrs. Williams
lines.translation:
当然可以，医生。
上楼吧。

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text:
You look very well, Jimmy.
You are better now,
but you mustn't get up yet.
You must stay in bed
for another two days.
lines.translation: 你看上去很好，吉米。你现在好些了，但你还不应该起床。你必须再卧床两天。

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text:
The boy mustn't
go to school yet, Mrs. Williams.
And he mustn't eat rich food.
lines.translation: 这孩子还不能去上学，威廉斯夫人，而且不能吃油腻的食物。

lines.speaker: Mrs. Williams
lines.text: Does he have a temperature, doctor?

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text:
Yes.
He must remain in bed
for another two days.
He can get up
for about two hours each day,
but you must keep the
room warm.
lines.translation: 是的，他还必须卧床两天。他每天可以起来两个小时，但您必须保持房间温暖。

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.translation: 威廉斯先生今晚去哪儿了？

lines.speaker: Mrs. Williams
lines.text:
He's in bed, doctor.
Can you see him please?
He has a bad cold, too!
lines.translation: 他在床上呢，医生。您能看看他吗？他也得了重感冒！

lesson.title: Before-listening question
lesson.instruction: Listen then answer this question. Who else is in bed today? Why? 听录音，然后回答问题。还有谁今天也卧床休息？为什么？
lesson.translation: Answer the question according to the dialogue. 根据对话回答问题。
lesson.context: At the end of the dialogue Mrs. Williams says Mr. Williams is in bed because he has a bad cold too.

questions.prompt: Who else is in bed today? Why?
questions.answer: Mr. Williams is in bed today because he has a bad cold, too.

items.title: He's better.
items.text: 在英文中，如果将一个人或物等与另一个人或物等进行比较，就可以用比较级。在这句话中，威廉斯夫人是把吉米今天的状况和前几天相比。形容词 well 的比较级形式不规则，意思是“健康状况有所好转”。

items.title: come upstairs
items.text: 上楼，此处 upstairs 是副词。

items.title: ... you mustn't get up yet.
items.text: yet 这个词一般用于否定句。get up 表示起床，在英语中有不少动词常与介词或副词连用，组成一个词组，称为动词短语，如 get up 就是一个动词短语。

items.title: for another two days,
items.text: for 引导的表示时间的短语往往可以译作“达”、“计”。本课中 for about two hours each day 可译为“每天可达两小时”。each day 是“每天”的意思。

lesson.text:
参考译文
医生：吉米今天怎么样了？
威廉斯夫人：他好些了。谢谢您，医生。
医生：我可以看看他吗，威廉斯夫人？
威廉斯夫人：当然可以，医生。上楼吧。

医生：你看上去很好，吉米。你现在好些了，但你还不应该起床。你必须再卧床两天。

医生：这孩子还不能去上学，威廉斯夫人，而且不能吃油腻的食物。
威廉斯夫人：他还发烧吗，医生？
医生：不，他不发烧了。
威廉斯夫人：他还必须卧床吗？
医生：是的，他还必须卧床两天。他每天可以起来两个小时，但您必须保持房间温暖。

医生：威廉斯先生今晚去哪儿了？
威廉斯夫人：他在床上呢，医生。您能看看他吗？他也得了重感冒！

practice.translation: Choose the correct word from the brackets and complete each sentence.

questions.prompt: Jimmy looks very ______ today. (good / well)
You must ______ Jimmy's room warm, Mrs. Williams. (have / keep)
Please don't ______ any noise, children. (do / make)
You mustn't ______ yet, Jimmy. You are not better yet. (stand / get up)
Does she ______ flu, doctor? (do / have)
I have some good ______ for you. You can stay at home today. (new / news)
You mustn't talk in a ______. You must be quiet. (bookcase / library)
We have some books in the ______ in our living room. (bookcase / library)
Jimmy must ______ in bed for another two days. (go / remain)
The boy is very ill. He has a ______. (hot / temperature)
